test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Refrigeration & Air Conditioning Mechanic) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: maths
question: A shopkeeper sells sugar at 30 per kg, which he has bought at 24 per kg. Being dishonest, he also gives only y gm of sugar instead of 1000 gm that is mentioned on the weight. In this way, the shopkeeper manages to make an overall profit of 66(2)/(3)%. What is the value of y?
solution:
**Given:**

Cost Price (CP) = ₹24 per kg

Selling Price (SP) = ₹30 per kg

Actual weight given = y gm instead of 1000 gm

Overall profit = 66 ²/₃ %

**Formula used:**

Profit % = (Profit ÷ CP) × 100

Effective selling price depends on reduced weight

**Calculations:**

66 ²/₃ % = 200/3 %

⇒ Gain factor = 1 + 200/300 = 5/3

⇒ Effective SP per kg = 24 × 5/3 = 40

Shopkeeper charges ₹30 for y gm

⇒ Price per kg = (30 × 1000) ÷ y

⇒ (30 × 1000) ÷ y = 40

⇒ 30000 = 40y

⇒ y = 750 gm

**∴ The value of y is 750 grams.**
